title: Blockquote
summary: The blockquote element presents quoted content and optional source attribution.

description.main: Use the semantic <blockquote> element for quoted text from external sources, and add citation metadata using the cite attribute and a visible <cite> label when relevant.

attributes.cite: Optional URL to the source of the quote.
attributes.class: Optional utility classes for spacing or typography adjustments.

available.cite: Any valid absolute or relative URL

description.heading: Quote with citation
description.description: A semantic blockquote with source URL and visible author attribution.
